title: CommercialSession
description: Record of a Commercial Optimization Loop over a single chapter draft (roadmap P16). Unlike the Revision Controller — which optimizes craft dimensions toward an ABSOLUTE threshold — this loop is driven by SIMULATED READER reaction and is strictly COMPARISON-ONLY: it rewrites the draft, re-runs the reader simulation, and accepts the rewrite ONLY when readers relatively improved (retention/satisfaction up, no persona newly dropped). Two structural invariants, enforced here AND in code: `gating` const false (it never blocks a build, ADR-003) and `comparison_only` const true (its numbers are meaningful only as a RELATIVE before/after, never as an absolute 'this chapter scores N' truth — the North Star discipline). It rides the Runtime envelope beside the draft, never inside the frozen ChapterDraft schema. Deterministic gates still run on whichever draft the loop finally selects, via the normal execute path.
